fields.description: Applied to Sales Invoices that don't set one. 01 = normal sale.
fields.label: Default Transaction Code

fields.description: Statutory VAT rate stated on the faktur (12% since Jan 2025).
fields.label: Tarif PPN (%)

fields.description: For non-luxury goods/services: DPP Nilai Lain = 11/12 × selling price, so the 12% rate collects an effective 11%.
fields.label: Use DPP Nilai Lain (PMK 131/2024)

fields.description: When a submitted Payment Entry has a deduction row using one of these accounts, an Expected Bukti Potong is created automatically.
fields.label: Withholding Deduction Accounts

fields.description: Customers in these groups are treated as government treasurers, so their orders and invoices are flagged automatically. A customer can still be flagged individually.
fields.label: Pemungut Customer Groups

fields.description: Applied to a Sales Invoice for a pemungut buyer that doesn't set one. 02 = instansi pemerintah (bendahara); switch an invoice to 03 for a BUMN or other pemungut.
fields.label: Transaction Code for Pemungut Buyers
Output VAT Accounts
fields.description: Accounts that represent PPN Keluaran. On a government (pemungut/WAPU) invoice, Taxes and Charges rows posting to these accounts are removed — the buyer deposits that PPN itself, so charging it again would double-count it. Other charges (freight/Ongkos Kirim, packing, handling) are never touched. Leave empty to detect output VAT automatically (account type "Tax" with root type "Liability").
Default account and rate per company for each kind of government-collected tax (Piutang PPN Bendahara, PPh 22 Dibayar di Muka). Used to pre-fill a charge the accountant adds to an invoice.
fields.label: Government Tax Defaults
Taxable Charges on the Faktur
fields.description: A charge billed INSIDE the PPN base — freight taxed by an "On Previous Row Total" PPN row — is part of the DPP but is not an item, so it needs its own faktur line. Map each such account here. Charges billed outside the PPN need no mapping.

fields.label: Read tax documents when they are attached
fields.description: An NPWP card, KTP or SKT/SPPKP attached to a Customer or Supplier is read in the background and its number, registered name and address are offered on the Tax Identity card. Needs the OCR pack on the bench (rapidocr-onnxruntime) for images and scans; born-digital PDFs read without it.

fields.label: Fill blank identity fields automatically
fields.description: Only a BLANK field is ever filled, and only from a number the document states twice (or a born-digital PDF). A value already on the party is never overwritten: a difference is shown as a suggestion. Every automatic fill can be undone from the card.
